SECTION 24 / CORE SYLLABUS
02. Repository and Working Tree

SIMPLE ENGLISH
A repository contains objects and refs; the working tree contains checked-out files you edit. The
index stores the proposed next snapshot.
සිංහJලෙන් Working tree එJකේ files edit කරනවා. Repository එJකේ history සහ refs තිJයනවා. සාමාන්‍ය repo
